sources.title: Carlyle completes strategic majority stake acquisition in Nido Home Finance

synopsis: Carlyle Asia Partners has completed its acquisition of a strategic majority stake in Nido Home Finance through an investment exceeding ₹2,000 crore, combining a primary capital infusion of ₹1,450 crore and a secondary purchase of a 45 percent stake from Edelweiss for about ₹600 crore. The deal, first announced in February 2026, received all necessary regulatory approvals. Following the transaction and capital infusion, Edelweiss retains roughly 26 percent ownership in Nido on a fully diluted basis. The fresh capital aims to nearly triple Nido's net worth to around ₹2,300 crore over the next 18 months, boosting its lending capacity and supporting its expansion into affordable housing finance markets.
